programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo where he discovers a radically new cooking attitude. He visits Tokyos largest fresh fish market and is introduced to the culinary diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Bangkok, Thailand: A spontaneous layover in Bangkok leads Bourdain into the city, where he tries strange meals of deep fried frog skins and pla rah - a fish paste that has fermented for three months to a year.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Napa, CA - Marooned in San Francisco, Tony tastes local shellfish and durian ice cream before embarking on a pilgrimage to experience the genius of Thomas Keller, chef and owner of The French Laundry.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY Provincetown, MA - Experience the formative moments of Tonys career as he revisits his first job, the culinary institute that taught him the basics, a normal workday at Les Halles Brasserie, and his mysterious mentor, Bigfoot.
programme.sub-title: My Life As a Cook - NYC

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Chaing Mai, Thailand: Jumping into a Thai tuk tuk taxi, Bourdain attempts to soak up Thai culture and get lost in the cuisine of Chaing Mai. From spicy soups and noodles in the busy city, to the hospitality and delicate salads of the countryside, Tony learns to appreciate all things Thai.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia - Tony plays spy in Russia and sets off to locate the best blinis and borscht St. Petersburg has to offer.
programme.sub-title: The Cook Who Came In From the Cold

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia - Tony continues his mission with a tour of local working class specialties. He tries his hand at ice-fishing, drinks a lot of vodka, feasts on Russian foods, eats smoked fish and ends the outing with a dip in the outdoor cold pool.
programme.sub-title: So Much Vodka, So Little Time

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Kansas City, Kansas, and Houston, Texas, and North Carolina: Which style of barbecue reigns supreme - Kansas City, Houston, or North Carolina? Anthony Bourdain journeys to all three, judging the secrets behind sauces, wood pits, and slow smokers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Los Angeles - CA, New York chef, Anthony Bourdain, descends into the culinary underbelly of his metropolitan nemesis, Los Angeles, where he experiences the trials of celebrity fame and the joys of West Coast cuisine.
programme.sub-title: Los Angeles, My Own Heart of Darkness

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fishermans soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Melbourne, Australia: Melbourne boasts a bunch of hard-living, good-natured, and eccentric food-lovers. In search of the outlaws of food, Tony explores a pasteurization-free cheese factory, and an old-world cured jamon workshop. Alas, no trip to Australia is complete without an authentic "barbie", so Bourdain settles down with new found friends for an afternoon meal of surf n' turf.
programme.sub-title: Down Under: The Wild West of Cooking

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Hanoi, Vietnam: Tony returns to his beloved Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday, Tet. Together, the friends enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New Orleans, Louisiana: In New Orleans, Anthony Bourdain catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world famous sno cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and finally kicks back to enjoy some local jazz.
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Cambodia: With a friend along for the ride, Tony travels to Phnom Penh, Cambodia, where he explores a food culture that is both pleasing to the palette and slightly frightening.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Brazil: What is Carioca? These natives of Rio de Janeiro are lovable scamps who somehow find ways to avoid work altogether, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars. Mr. Bourdain, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try, enjoying a savage tan, Brazilian barbecue, and one too many Caipirinhas!

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Morocco (Sahara) Tony traverses the Moroccan desert with one goal in mind: eat a mud-oven-roasted sheep.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, New York: Join Anthony Bourdain on his quest to characterize the perfect bar. With him, discover the importance of a "maniacal bartender", the proper chemical makeup of drinks, the joys of seedy dive-bars, and the need for late night snacks.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Singapore: Chef Anthony Bourdain decides to find the real Singapore with its multicultural restaurants and markets. He samples prescription food dishes, explores the Geyland Serai Market, rides the clean and efficient subway, and sees Singapore's diversity in the "Little India" neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: Singapore: New York in Twenty Years

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Sydney, Australia: Bourdain embarks on a pilgrimage through Australia to indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs, Tetsuya Wakuda. Days, miles and many Australian meals later, Anthony finds himself unable to describe Tetsuya's delicious and well-earned meal.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY - Passionate about his city, Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, pan-seared foie gras, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Oaxaca, Mexico - Chef Tony Bourdain explores the exotic and colorful indigenous zone of Mexicos Oaxaca region where he tastes toasted grasshoppers and other delicacies. His adventure ends with mariachi music and, of course, lots of tequila.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: St. Martin: In an attempt to escape the stress of city life, Anthony visits the island of St. Martin. In this Caribbean paradise, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, discovers foodstuffs not available at American supermarkets, and finally relaxes at a beach bar.
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better with Sand Between Your Toes

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Minneapolis, Minnesota: Tony travels to the grain belt capitol, Minneapolis, to inspect the conflict between creative independent operators and generic franchises. Beginning in the food nightmare within the Mall of America, Anthony vows to find good cuisine within the city.
programme.sub-title: The Struggle for the Soul of America

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: London, England - In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal & South-West France: Visiting his boss's family farm, Tony helps slaughter and feast on a pig the family has been fattening all year. Then, Tony heads to France to experience the rich delights of a foie gras farm.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland - Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo where he discovers a radically new cooking attitude. He visits Tokyos largest fresh fish market and is introduced to the culinary diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Mekong River, Vietnam: On the river, Tony drinks a lot of Mekong moonshine with the welcoming owners of a duck farm. Although seduced by his Vietnam experience, Tony is not sure the royal dish Birds Nest Soup is all its cracked up to be.

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: In 1863, Mississippi farmer Newt Knight serves as a medic for the Confederate Army. Opposed to slavery, Knight would rather help the wounded than fight the Union. After his nephew dies in battle, Newt returns home to Jones County to safeguard his family but is soon branded an outlaw deserter. Forced to flee, he finds refuge with a group of runaway slaves hiding out in the swamps. Forging an alliance with the slaves and other farmers, Knight leads a rebellion that would forever change history.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: A recently released convict takes murderous revenge against his childhood friends who let him take the fall for their crimes.

programme.title: Slow Burn
programme.desc: As ambitious District Attorney Ford Cole (Ray Liotta) prepares for his mayoral bid, he faces conflicting stories surrounding a man's death. His assistant DA and sometime lover, Nora Timmer (Jolene Blalock), claims that the man tried to rape her. However, witness Luther Pinks (LL Cool J) tells a different tale. He says that, actually, she tried to seduce the victim to gather information about a mob chieftain.

programme.title: In the Mix
programme.desc: Mobster Frank (Chazz Palminteri) hires hip DJ Darrell (Usher) to man the turntables at a party for his gorgeous daughter, Dolly (Emmanuelle Chriqui). At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him.

programme.title: School Dance
programme.desc: A teen (Bobb'e J. Thompson) hopes to impress a girl he likes by winning a spot on his school's hottest dance crew.

programme.title: The Cookout
programme.desc: College basketball player Todd Anderson (Storm P) signs a $30 million deal with the New Jersey Nets and promptly moves to a wealthy suburb. His mother (Jenifer Lewis), however, insists that Todd remain connected to his humbler roots. So Todd decides to hold a good old-fashioned cookout at his new mansion. But this turns out to be more difficult than he expected, and his old friends and relatives clash with the sophisticated characters that have recently come into his life.

programme.title: Crossover
programme.desc: The lives of a gifted athlete (Wesley Jonathan) and his best friend (Anthony Mackie) change when they take a fateful trip to Los Angeles.

programme.title: A Woman Called Moses
programme.desc: Tubman is a slave whose new owner claims to be a fair man, but treats her harshly; she finds inspiration to escape for freedom in the North.

programme.title: A Woman Called Moses
programme.desc: At the risk of recapture, Harriet Tubman helps organize the Underground Railroad, which enables hundreds of enslaved African Americans to make their way to the freedom of the North.

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: In 1863, Mississippi farmer Newt Knight serves as a medic for the Confederate Army. Opposed to slavery, Knight would rather help the wounded than fight the Union. After his nephew dies in battle, Newt returns home to Jones County to safeguard his family but is soon branded an outlaw deserter. Forced to flee, he finds refuge with a group of runaway slaves hiding out in the swamps. Forging an alliance with the slaves and other farmers, Knight leads a rebellion that would forever change history.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

programme.title: Number One With a Bullet
programme.desc: Detectives Barzak (Robert Carradine) and Hazeltine (Billy Dee Williams) are trying their hardest to bring down a drug ring, but they're meeting with trouble at every turn, which leads the officers to suspect a mole in their midst. When the detectives are dissuaded by their superiors from following a lead about the man behind the whole operation, Barzak and Hazeltine are forced to find the truth on their own without the support of their department.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. At the last minute, they are joined by John (Stephen Dorff), Frank's brother. Stuck in gridlock traffic, the guys take a shortcut that gets them lost. In a very dangerous neighborhood, they witness a murder by a gang leader called Fallon (Denis Leary). They flee, but Fallon now wants them hunted down and eliminated.

programme.title: Proud
programme.desc: In the 1990s, Lorenzo DuFau tells the story of the USS Mason, the historic World War II battleship with an entirely segregated black crew. Aware of their deadly mission, the sailors aboard the USS Mason engage in fierce combat and fight to defend their country, despite the overwhelming racism back home in America. But even without the support of their nation, the crew members dedicate themselves to completing their mission and returning home alive.

programme.title: House Arrest
programme.desc: DeAndre (Jayceon Taylor) becomes involved in a computer chip scheme, and his girlfriend is charged with the crime and placed under house arrest.

programme.title: Number One With a Bullet
programme.desc: Detectives Barzak (Robert Carradine) and Hazeltine (Billy Dee Williams) are trying their hardest to bring down a drug ring, but they're meeting with trouble at every turn, which leads the officers to suspect a mole in their midst. When the detectives are dissuaded by their superiors from following a lead about the man behind the whole operation, Barzak and Hazeltine are forced to find the truth on their own without the support of their department.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police chief Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) investigates the gruesome murder of Donald Pater, one of the wealthiest residents on a Caribbean island. He was found decapitated in his Jacuzzi. Although the local political establishment, especially crooked Governor Chalk (Norman Beaton), insists that small-time thief Maubee (Robert Townsend) is responsible, Xavier has his doubts. This view is complicated by the police chief's personal history with Maubee: The men have been friends since childhood.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Meet the Blacks
programme.desc: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President Obama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.
programme.sub-title: Cantina Culture and the Morning After?

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.
programme.sub-title: Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table and today, Lidia shares a simple menu for a party based around fish. In the summertime, she likes to turn on the grill and make Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini with Tomato Salsa. She serves them with Seared Salmon Paillards with Arugula Salad; and finally, Cody Hogan from Lidia's Kansas City joins Lidia in the kitchen and they make Monkfish Meatballs served in tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia talks about growing up and family traditions in this episode. Featured recipes include Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a Roasted Garlic Crostini and Papperdelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms. A refreshing "Panache" is shared with her mother Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grains are back in style, yet Italians have been using them for centuries. Lidia shares some of her favorite grain based recipes in this episode including: Risotto with Mushrooms; Barley, Kale & Butternut Squash Risotto; and Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savory Cabbage.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her flagship restaurant's favorite recipes that can be made at home. They include "gnudi" (Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings); and a flavorful Whole Roasted Branzino. She'll also be talking "restaurant secrets" with some of her chefs in this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up along the Adriatic sea so picnics at the beach were a common occurrence. Recipes in this episode include some seafood classics from the southern part of Italy including Orecchiette with Peas and Asparagus; Mussels with Farro, Cannellini and Chickpeas and a quick and delicious Chocolate Fig dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian cuisine is known for seasonal ingredients and simple techniques. In today's episode, Lidia will share recipes that master simplicity: Sausages with Fennel & Olives; Orange and Red Salad and a delicious "Almost a Tiramisu" recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta with pear and pecorino is a restaurant favorite at Felidia, and Lidia shows how to take that flavor combination and use it in a risotto. She also demonstrates Short Ribs Braised in Barolo with Orzo.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia reminisces about her Grandma's cantina (cellar) and how she spent every summer helping her grandmother prepare the food from the bounty of the harvest for the fall and winter months. Lidia's cantina has evolved into a pantry, and in this episode she will prepare pantry friendly dishes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.
programme.sub-title: Cooking as a Kid in New York

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavor in the kitchen, as Italians began to grow their produce in America. Lidia makes a Belgian & Red Endive Salad as well as a sweet Cherry Jam Tart wrapped up in an almond crust.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Ingredients that were foraged included asparagus, mushrooms, clams, and mussels, and this seasonal adventure was always extremely exciting. Lidia begins with a hearty Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu. She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In Lidia's courtyard, the fruit trees would blossom with flowers in spring. In the summer, it was time to play around the trees and wait for the fruit to ripen. Today, Lidia prepares a Fig and Prosciutto Bruschetta, a delicious combination of sweet and salty. She then transforms wafer cookies into Quick & Easy Truffles. Finally, it's time for a light and airy Almond Tart from Andria.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode is all about corn. Lidia often played in corn fields, helped with the harvests, and even slept on mattresses made from husks. Recipes for today include a refreshing Corn and Zucchini Minestra, a sweet and savory Polenta Cacio e Pere, and a combination of vegetables that can be served as a side dish or even the highlight of the dinner table- Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.
programme.sub-title: Corn: From the Kernel to the Husk

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow II
programme.desc: A policeman (Leslie Cheung) and a reformed gangster (Ti Lung) meet their dead friend's twin, employed by a New York mob boss.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: Bloodfist II
programme.desc: The world kickboxing champion (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) retreats to Manila, lands in a mess and fights his way out.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

programme.title: Before I Go to Sleep
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Brain on Fire
programme.desc: Susannah Cahalan, an up-and-coming journalist at the New York Post, became plagued by voices in her head and seizures. As weeks progress and Susannah quickly moves deeper into insanity, her behaviors shift from violence to catatonia. After a series of tantrums, misdiagnoses, and a lengthy hospital stay, a doctor's last-minute intervention enables him to give her a diagnosis and a chance to rebuild her life.

Troubled Italian filmmaker Guido Anselmi (Marcello Mastroianni) struggles with creative stasis as he attempts to get a new movie off the ground. Overwhelmed by his work and personal life, the director retreats into his thoughts, which often focus on his loves, both past and present, and frequently wander into fantastical territory. As he tries to sort out his many entanglements, romantic and otherwise, Anselmi finds his production becoming more and more autobiographical.

programme.title: Among Wolves
programme.desc: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear of Everything
programme.desc: Becoming paranoid after his research into serial killers, a writer (Simon Pegg) must confront his numerous demons in order to make it to an important meeting about his screenplay.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Bloodfist III: Forced to Fight
programme.desc: An innocent half-Asian kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) is caught between two other races at war in prison.

programme.title: Coffee and Cigarettes
programme.desc: This 11-vignette film focuses on the human interactions that happen while partaking in the everyday indulgence of coffee and cigarettes. Featuring well-known actors and other artists as themselves or some version thereof, the film highlights the nuances and subtle hostilities that can be a part of seemingly normal conversations. Bill Murray waits on the Wu-Tang Clan, Iggy Pop and Tom Waits get on each others' nerves and Jack and Meg White of the White Stripes discuss Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
programme.desc: Residents of California's San Fernando Valley are under attack by flying saucers from outer space. The aliens, led by Eros (Dudley Manlove) and his assistant, Tanna (Joanna Lee), intend to conquer the planet by resurrecting corpses in a Hollywood cemetery. The living dead -- a cape-wearing ghoul (Bela Lugosi), a vampire (Vampira) and a slow-footed cop (Tor Johnson) who was killed for his nosiness -- stalk curious humans who wander into the cemetery looking for evidence of the UFOs.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Jeffrey
programme.desc: Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance.

(Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an 'Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his 'An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.desc: A family feud dating back to WWI comes to a head after the unveiling of a war memorial in Midsomer Parva, when a retired colonel is found dead. What would be a dream of joy, quickly turns into a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Black Game Night

programme.title: Meli

programme.title: Droppin Bodies

Abandoned by a justice system that fails to bring her daughter's killer to account, she's forced to confront the darkness she once escaped.

programme.title: Krooked Lines

Two friends, one motivated by the law, the other motivated by money, try to bring down a human trafficking ring, while dealing with the death of a lover, and revelation of an undercover affair. The bond must survive, even when there is no one to trust.

programme.title: Art of Love

programme.title: Good Deed Gone Bad
programme.desc: Tyler, a tech nerd working in corporate America stumbles across a random cellphone in the back of his uber car on his way home from work. Hesitant to turn the device to his shifty driver, he decides that with his knowledge and understanding of technology, he can find the owner on his own. Not knowing that returning this phone could very well cost him his life, he pursues the journey of doing a good deed that will go very bad.

programme.title: The Best Thing!

Determined to find out if this kid is his, Justin recognizes being united with this child could have frightening consequences. Or it could be The Best Thing!

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run. While Tess and Nick enjoy their honeymoon in Fiji, Stevie becomes intent on proving that she can run the property on her own.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess is thrilled to have her cousin to stay but soon discovers that Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark. Mark was killed in a riding accident at an equestrian event where Jaz was a star on the rise.
programme.sub-title: The Things We Do For Love

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Meg heads home early from the city in hopes she can be of some comfort to Tess during her time out with Nick. But Meg has little success getting Tess to open up.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The stubborn side of Dave is exposed when he finds an injured horse and believes he has found a descendent, a Waler, of the first settlement horses. Meanwhile, Jodi's life is in a downward spiral as her continued absences from work force Stevie to fire her, and her personal life takes a hit too.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their initial meeting doesn't go well when they aren't capable of confessing their love.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio, which causes her to get involved in with a mystery man. Meanwhile, Sandra offers Kate a farm manager's job.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four. Kate is now working with Sandra as an overseer at Kinsella's. Jodi has gone into business for herself, selling cosmetics, and the work is tough.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club, she isn't prepared for the old feelings it's about to stir up. For Jodi, the reunion is fraught with tension as she faces her old rival, Natalie, and she ends up introducing Luke as the local mechanic, rather than as her boyfriend.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Harry suffers a stroke, he reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial. Helping Tess with the hay, he works recklessly and has a frightful accident with the hay bales.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run. He is also the father of Rose, a daughter he has no idea exists. Will is at first shocked to learn he is a father but delights Stevie by wanting to know all about their daughter.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp, but his problems only escalate. Stevie urges Jodi to distance herself from Luke, but Jodi needs to give him one final chance. She rushes to the truck stop and is shattered to discover drugs hidden in Luke's wardrobe.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems. Ultimately, Stevie must rely on Regan's help to escape a life-threatening farm accident and Regan must face her fears to save Stevie.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia. As they fall for each other, Kate realises Regan has a secret she'll do anything to protect.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess learns Nick has been offered a job in Argentina and she makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months. Meanwhile, Stevie takes care of Charlotte for the afternoon, but when the child goes missing, she turns Drovers Run upside down to find her. As Dave and Regan's romance blossoms, Kate is devastated.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick. Stevie is now in charge, and she decides Kate and Jodi need to sort out who's going to take on her old overseer's job.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan so that she can get to an appointment. Kate tries to avoid Dave during a birdcall competition, but he makes it difficult.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kate's grandmother comes for a visit and Kate is in hot water because her grandmother believes that she's engaged to Dave and she runs Drovers Run.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic. The approach of a raging dust storm adds to the troubles at Drovers Run and Stevie struggles to save the life of Tess's horse Oscar.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose when she learns that Alex won't be taking her to the ball. The wrong hose causes a tank to fill with toxic gas, and Alex shows up to help, but he is overcome by the fumes.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis, which temporarily eases tensions between them.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie thrilled at the prospect of a visit from Rose but things sour when Stevie's sister Michelle arrives with her. Protective of her adopted daughter, Michelle doesn't want the usually rash Stevie to take matters into her own hands and tell Rose the truth about who her real mother is.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Caught off guard when Rose discovers a baby's hospital bracelet, Stevie tells a half-truth: she did have a baby, but she put it up for adoption. Rose finds out the whole truth and takes off in the ute, accidentally reversing into the cattle yard gates.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Patrick, Dave's adventurer brother literally parachutes onto Drovers Run and ensnares Kate's heart. In the wake of Patrick's appearance, Dave must deal with painful memories and a shocking family secret that's been hidden for years.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is on top of the world when she receives a birthday gift from the deceased Jack McLeod. Meanwhile, Dave begins training a new veterinary student. Alex wants to get out of doing an interview for local radio, which Harry has delegated to him.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Dave is forced to question his behaviour when his former student, Catriona, threatens him with a sexual harassment suit. Meanwhile, after confronting Meg about Jack's gift to her, Jodi feels that her whole life has been a lie.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Meg agonises over Jodi's rejection of her, following the revelation that Jack McLeod is possibly her real father. Jodi reads her mother's novel, which is based on real life and details the mystery surrounding her birth.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess returns home to Drovers Run, she discovers the exciting news that she's pregnant. Her joy is soon turned to grief, though, when a call comes from Argentina saying that the plane Nick was traveling on has been reported missing.
programme.sub-title: Twelve and A Half Hours Behind

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess has been holed up in her room since the news of Nick's death, but she suddenly reappears, strong and composed. She throws herself back into work and declares she wants to hold a party to celebrate Nick's life.

programme.title: Impetigore
programme.desc: A woman inherits a house in her ancestral village, but she is unaware that members of the community have been trying to locate and kill her to remove the curse that has plagued them for years.

programme.title: Lake of Death

programme.title: All Hallows' Eve 2
programme.desc: A woman finds a VHS tape that shows a series of gruesome tales.

programme.title: Revenge
programme.desc: Jen is enjoying a romantic getaway with her wealthy boyfriend -- until his two sleazy friends arrive for an unannounced hunting trip.
